normalization: ASCII letter case ignored; digits exact
skipping: No11/20 character majority; missing/nonalphanumeric cannot be keys
candidate_scoring: Same fixed key denominator; missing candidate character mismatches; self-vote included
positions: Left-aligned; widths from maximum prediction length per image
scope: All available canonical CryptBB/DarkBay study runs plus archived DarkBay seed runs; exact20 prediction sets only; no partial committee substitution
duplicate_policy: Prefer canonical epoch_XX, reserved251_cpu, requested_cpu, interim_cuda, then other; lexical order within preference; checkpoint hashes must agree
legacy_adapters: Legacy M3 final20 uses prediction freeze linked to completion and frozen training protocol. Archived seed runs use per-epoch freeze+protocol, ignore confidence, and validate all900 opaque IDs.
